proposals.evidence: DEDR 4410 explicitly attests Tamil/Malayalam pēr, Kota pēr, Telugu pēru, Gadaba/Parji pidir, Gondi peder/porol, Tulu pudaru and Konda/Kuvi dōru name. The selected simple name nouns fit these branches; Indo-Aryan nām forms and potentially contact-mediated Kannada pēru are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
